claims.claim: Dean says Hobb has created a number of small intimate settings centred around her characters.
claims.source: Christopher Luke Dean, 'The Greatest Fictional World Builders: Robin Hobb', Writers Write, 2020
claims.quote: created a number of small intimate settings centred around her characters

claims.claim: Dean says Hobb makes her readers care for her setting as much as her characters.
claims.source: Christopher Luke Dean, 'The Greatest Fictional World Builders: Robin Hobb', Writers Write, 2020
claims.quote: make her readers care for her setting as much as her characters

claims.claim: Dean says Hobb's characters grow or die or get worse rather than remaining stable.
claims.source: Christopher Luke Dean, 'The Greatest Fictional World Builders: Robin Hobb', Writers Write, 2020
claims.quote: Her characters grow or die or get worse

claims.claim: Outcalt says the epigraphs at the beginning of each chapter carry historical facts about the Six Duchies.
claims.source: Jeffrey Outcalt, 'On the use of epigraphs and metanarratives in Robin Hobb's Assassin's Apprentice', 2024
claims.quote: The epigraphs at the beginning of each chapter will have historical facts

claims.claim: Outcalt characterises the opening in-world history epigraph of Assassin's Apprentice as informative yet boring.
claims.source: Jeffrey Outcalt, Substack craft essay on Hobb's epigraphs, 2024
claims.quote: A pretty informative, yet boring, introduction epigraph

claims.claim: Outcalt says the framing makes the reader feel they are reading from the same tome the narrator scribed.
claims.source: Jeffrey Outcalt, Substack craft essay on Hobb's epigraphs, 2024
claims.quote: It reads as if we are reading from the same tome

claims.claim: Outcalt says the bias in the Queen Desire epigraph alerts the reader to the potential of an unreliable narrator.
claims.source: Jeffrey Outcalt, Substack craft essay on Hobb's epigraphs, 2024
claims.quote: This should immediately alert us to the potential of an unreliable narrator

claims.claim: Outcalt says Hobb leaves it to the reader to do light investigative work rather than cutting to flashback.
claims.source: Jeffrey Outcalt, Substack craft essay on Hobb's epigraphs, 2024
claims.quote: leaves it up to the reader to do some light investigative work

claims.claim: Outcalt says some epigraphs raise details about characters that are disclosed nowhere else in the book.
claims.source: Jeffrey Outcalt, Substack craft essay on Hobb's epigraphs, 2024
claims.quote: details about the characters in ways that are NOT disclosed anywhere else

claims.claim: Outcalt describes a slow congealing of fact and fiction across the sequence of epigraphs.
claims.source: Jeffrey Outcalt, Substack craft essay on Hobb's epigraphs, 2024
claims.quote: the slow congealing of fact and fiction in the epigraphs

claims.claim: Page identifies an unremitting rhythm of buts at all levels of the story as a device in Fool's Assassin.
claims.source: M Harold Page, novelist, 'Fool's Assassin: How Robin Hobb Writes Lyrical Fantasy Without Being Boring', Black Gate, 2016
claims.quote: an unremitting rhythm of buts at all levels of the story

claims.claim: Page says a death arising from the thriller plot has domestic and child-rearing implications in Fool's Assassin.
claims.source: M Harold Page, novelist, Black Gate craft dissection of Fool's Assassin, 2016
claims.quote: a death resulting from the Thriller has domestic and child-rearing implications

claims.claim: Page says the same duty in Fool's Assassin manifests both domestically and politically.
claims.source: M Harold Page, novelist, Black Gate craft dissection of Fool's Assassin, 2016
claims.quote: the same duty manifests both domestically and politically

claims.claim: Page says Hobb only delivers description when it is part of a conflict.
claims.source: M Harold Page, novelist, Black Gate craft dissection of Fool's Assassin, 2016
claims.quote: She only delivers description when it

claims.claim: Page says Hobb serves up characterisation only when it is immediately significant to a choice or tactic.
claims.source: M Harold Page, novelist, Black Gate craft dissection of Fool's Assassin, 2016
claims.quote: Hobb always serves up characterisation when it is immediately significant
